name: City of Alameda Summer Internship
what_you_do: You work a summer internship with the City of Alameda. The program page does not list the tasks.
who_can_apply: Students aged 16 and older. The program page does not list residency or other rules.
pay_detail: Not stated on the program page.
deadline_text: The program page says details are usually posted in March and applications are due in mid-May. It gives no year.
how_to_apply: Use the Application link on the program page. It goes to the city job site. Watch for the posting in March.
notes: The program page does not say if the job is paid, how long it lasts, or if a work permit is needed. Ask Human Resources at 510-747-4900.
